batch.title: Approve {{count}} items?
batch.message: Total value {{amount}}. Items needing a signature are skipped.

receipts.label: Missing original receipts / VAT slips
receipts.advice: Please attach clear photos or scans of original hotel/transport receipts and resubmit.

limit.label: Allowance or hotel bill above company limit
limit.advice: Please adjust the hotel or daily food allowance to match your grade travel policy limit.

tripNote.label: Trip approval note not attached
tripNote.advice: Attach your manager's travel approval note and visit schedule before resubmitting.

duplicate.label: Duplicate or unclear travel distance
duplicate.advice: Please check the local travel dates and fare amounts so there are no duplicate entries.

budget.label: Budget balance check needed
budget.advice: Please confirm available budget with Finance & Accounts before sending for final signature.

quotes.label: Need 3 vendor price quotes
quotes.advice: Please collect and attach at least 3 written vendor quotations for fair price comparison.

technical.label: Technical or warranty details unclear
technical.advice: Add clear model details, delivery timeline, and warranty period from the supplier.

negotiate.label: Negotiate better price or payment terms
negotiate.advice: Please ask the supplier for a better discount or standard 30-day payment after delivery.

busy.label: All office cars busy at requested time
busy.advice: Please adjust your departure time slightly or share a pooled ride heading in the same direction.

shuttle.label: Route covered by staff shuttle bus
shuttle.advice: Please use the scheduled staff shuttle bus unless carrying heavy samples or urgent client files.

purpose.label: Visit purpose needs more detail
purpose.advice: Please mention the client name, meeting time, or work purpose clearly in the booking form.

stock.label: Check existing store room stock first
stock.advice: Please check with HR/IT Store Room first to see if a spare unit is already available.

inspection.label: Need engineer inspection report
inspection.advice: Attach a short inspection note confirming why the current equipment cannot be repaired.

quote.label: Price estimate needs vendor quote
quote.advice: Attach a recent supplier price quote matching the requested model and warranty.

papers.label: Supporting papers missing
papers.advice: Please attach all supporting documents and receipts before submitting again.

manager.label: Manager review required first
manager.advice: Please review the details with your supervisor and resubmit.
